relation_rationale: Same lowest SpO2 first-attempt endpoint, measurement, window, randomized comparison and median-difference estimator. Target assignment effect includes all 192 randomized participants; reported intention-to-treat analysis includes 97 intervention and 93 control, excluding two randomized controls (postrandomization do-not-resuscitate order and operating-room intubation). This reported population restriction is retained as narrower, without asserting exact assignment-estimand correspondence. Its bias implications remain for independent RoB2 assessment.

comparison_groups.assignment: High-flow nasal cannula for preoxygenation and apnoeic oxygenation
Non-rebreather mask preoxygenation and standard nasal cannula apnoeic oxygenation

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.method: Pulse oximetry; lowest SpO2 during first intubation attempt
measurement.metric: Lowest SpO2 during the first intubation attempt

target.outcome_definition: Lowest SpO2 during the first intubation attempt

time_point_or_window.description: First intubation attempt, from paralytic administration to quantitative end-tidal carbon dioxide confirmation if successful, or start of second attempt if unsuccessful

reported.analysis_population: Reported intention-to-treat: intervention n=97 and control n=93; two of 95 randomized controls excluded because of a do-not-resuscitate order established after randomization and intubation in the operating room.
